data.name: Inspiratus Technologies SA
data.description: Inspiratus Technologies is a biochar-focused CDR subsidiary of the Belgian agribusiness holding Durabilis Group. In June 2025 it inaugurated a US$3 million industrial biochar plant in Sullana (Piura), Peru, designed to process 40,000 t/year of agricultural residues into 10,000 t/year of biochar, and it is a member of the CDR30 coalition.
